Daily: higher highs and higher lows; fast average above slow; 4.9% above the last swing high. Hourly: higher highs and higher lows; fast average above slow; 1.2% under the last swing high. Daily close vs the latest daily swing high: 1.3 daily ranges (ATR) above the last swing high (+4.9%), extended.
